item.title: Young Thug Says He’s Changing His Name ‘ASAP Bro’ Because of Jeffrey Epstein
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to the latest update in the world of hip-hop. We've got some interesting news for you today. Young Thug, the eccentric Atlanta rapper, has announced that he's planning to change his name.
[Short music transition]
Host: In a post on X on Wednesday, Thugger wrote, "I'm changing my f–king name asap bro." This seems to be in response to a post about convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein, who was accused of sex trafficking underage girls. Thug was likely reacting in disgust to the post, which featured photos of Epstein with minor girls.
[Short music transition]
Host: For those who may not know, Jeffrey Epstein was arrested in 2019 on charges of sex trafficking of minors and conspiracy to commit sex trafficking of minors. He died in his Manhattan jail cell later that year, with his death ruled a suicide.
[Short music transition]
Host: But back to Young Thug. This isn't the first time he's considered a name change. In 2018, he announced that he was changing his name to SEX, but it didn't quite stick. Fans and the music industry still referred to him as Young Thug.
[Short music transition]
Host: Meek Mill has already chimed in, wondering what Thug's new name might be. As of now, there's no word on what the new name will be. We'll have to wait and see what Thugger decides.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today. Young Thug is also making waves in the music scene, with recent performances at Coachella and a spot on The New York Times' list of the 30 Greatest Living American Songwriters. We'll be keeping an eye on this story and bringing you updates as more information becomes available. Thanks for tuning in!
